Table~\ref{tab:hands-available} holds the hands that can be had: sold, open-source, or with no release status stated. A row whose joint count no source states sorts last rather than being ranked by a number nobody stated. Its empty-cell count covers the eight specification columns, DoF through price; the hand, maker, open-hardware, status and usage columns are left out of it because they are never blank and counting them would dilute the finding. \emph{force N} is not a ranking: read \emph{force kind} first, because pull-out resistance, pinch force, a fingertip normal force under an indenter and an unlabelled vendor number are different measurements. \emph{uses} counts the method rows whose own experiments run on that hand.
